metadata.name: syndicate_program
metadata.description: Syndicate Solana/Anchor on-chain program: vault custody, deposits/claims/refunds, fees, and v1 backend-trusted settlement with conservation + signed-price checks.

instructions.name: begin_live
docs: Advance Sealing → Live. Operator-gated; requires the seal deadline reached and the
begin_live window open. Reads the confirmed seats (passed as `remaining_accounts`
in engine order, read-only), counts sealers for audit, and derives the dealer
button ON-CHAIN from the recorded seal commitments:
```text
seed   = keccak256("syndicate:button:v2" ‖ match_key ‖ lock_ts(u64 LE)
‖ for each confirmed seat in engine order:
player(32) ‖ commitment_set(1) ‖ prediction_commitment(32)
‖ timelock_target(u64 LE))
button = u64::from_le_bytes(seed[0..8]) % confirmed_count
Non-sealers are NOT dropped (v2): every confirmed seat plays; the backend assigns
the feed spot price at seal-close to seats without a commitment. Zero sealers is
valid.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pull-based, idempotent claim of a settled seat's payout (confirmed seats only —
unconfirmed candidates use `refund`).

instructions.name: create_and_deposit
docs: Atomic create + seat the creator (as the first CANDIDATE) in a single instruction.
The creator (`authority`) is both the payer and the first depositor; their seat's
`room_commitment` is the match's `room_commitment` (hash(roomcode ‖ creator) for
private rooms, zero for public).

instructions.name: create_match
docs: Create a match. **Permissionless**: any signer may create; the signer becomes
`m.authority` but that grants NO lifecycle power — `lock`/`begin_live`/
`submit_settlement` remain gated to operator ROLE keys.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit buy-in + entry fee → seat CANDIDACY. Confirmation happens at `lock`
(backend FCFS by deposit finality). For private rooms, `join_commitment` must be
`sha256(roomcode ‖ player_pubkey)` (recorded for audit; verified off-chain by the
backend before confirming the seat). Entry fees are NOT accrued to the treasury
here — unconfirmed candidates get them back in full via `refund`.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialize the global protocol role registry and pause flags.

instructions.name: lock
docs: Lock the match: confirm the playing set and freeze it, status → Sealing.
`remaining_accounts` = the confirmed seat PDAs (writable), in the backend's FCFS
order — position `i` becomes `engine_seat = i`. Everything else stays a candidate
and becomes refundable immediately (see `refund`). Confirmed entry fees accrue to
the treasury here. Operator-gated.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Pull-based, idempotent refund. v2 single rule: the amount is always the seat's
full `deposit + entry_fee_paid`.
- Unconfirmed candidate: refundable the moment the match leaves Filling (lock
landed without them, or any void) — including after Settled.
- Confirmed seat: refundable only on Void (settled seats use `claim`).

instructions.name: set_match_bounds
docs: Update the operator-governed match-creation bounds (config_admin). New matches must
pick buy-in / fill window / total betting duration within these ranges.

instructions.name: set_pauses
docs: Pause/unpause new exposure or settlement submission. Claims/refunds remain live.

instructions.name: set_price_signer
docs: Rotate the Ethereum/secp256k1 address trusted for signed settlement prices.

instructions.name: submit_settlement
docs: Submit the final settlement (backend-trusted payouts).
Verifies the signed price at exactly `scheduled_end_ts`, writes per-seat payouts
supplied by the backend for ALL confirmed seats (non-sealers included — the
backend settled them with the seal-close spot price), and enforces conservation:
`Σ payouts == confirmed_count × buy_in − rake_collected`.
Pass the confirmed seats as `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: void
docs: Operator emergency void (oracle/timelock fault, incident). Status → Void with
`Emergency` kind: full refund to all.

instructions.name: void_before_start
docs: Permissionless void of an abandoned pre-LIVE match — no operator needed, so funds
can never strand. Filling past `fill_deadline_ts`, or Sealing past
`seal_deadline_ts + SEAL_VOID_GRACE_SEC` (operator failed to begin_live). Full
refund either way.

instructions.name: void_live_after_deadline
docs: Permissionless void of a stuck LIVE match (capital-safety backstop). Reads ONLY
the `MatchAccount`. Anyone may call once `now >= scheduled_end_ts +
SETTLE_VOID_GRACE_SEC`, guaranteeing funds can never strand if the operator
vanishes after the match goes live. Full refund to all.

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Withdraw fees to the protocol treasury. Settled → confirmed entry fees + rake
(`total_fees`). Voids waive all fees (nothing to withdraw). Idempotent via
`fees_withdrawn`.

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Action not allowed in the current match status.

errors.name: MatchFull
errors.msg: Match is full.

errors.name: NotEnoughPlayers
errors.msg: Not enough players to start.

errors.name: ConservationViolation
errors.msg: Conservation check failed: payouts + fees != deposits.

errors.name: InvalidSettlementInput
errors.msg: Oracle/settlement inputs invalid or insufficient.

errors.name: InvalidOracleProof
errors.msg: Signed price proof is missing, unauthenticated, or not from the whitelisted signer.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Seat already claimed.

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Protocol action is paused.

errors.name: InvalidSeat
errors.msg: Seat is invalid or duplicated.

errors.name: SeatSetMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement did not include exactly the confirmed seats.

errors.name: PredictionCommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: Prediction reveal does not match signed commitment.

errors.name: SettlementDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Settlement deadline passed; use void/refund path.

errors.name: FeesAlreadyWithdrawn
errors.msg: Match fees were already withdrawn.

errors.name: ButtonNotSet
errors.msg: Dealer button has not been recorded.

errors.name: SealWindowClosed
errors.msg: Seal window has closed; commitment rejected (after seal_deadline_ts).

errors.name: SealDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Seal deadline has not been reached; cannot begin live yet.

errors.name: FillDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Fill deadline has not been reached; cannot permissionlessly void yet.

errors.name: SettleGraceNotElapsed
errors.msg: Settlement grace has not elapsed; cannot permissionlessly void the live match yet.

errors.name: BeginLiveWindowPassed
errors.msg: begin_live window elapsed; the operator did not start the match in time (void only).

errors.name: AlreadySealed
errors.msg: Seat has already recorded a seal commitment.

errors.name: InvalidDrandRound
errors.msg: Timelock target round is invalid (must publish just after the latest match end).

errors.name: OracleToleranceTooWide
errors.msg: Oracle tolerance window is too wide; must be tight (single-update).

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Invalid match configuration parameter.

errors.name: RefundUnavailable
errors.msg: Refund not available for this seat in the current match state.

errors.name: SeatNotConfirmed
errors.msg: Seat was not confirmed into the playing set at lock.

errors.name: CandidateLimitReached
errors.msg: Candidate limit reached for this match.

errors.name: InvalidRoomCommitment
errors.msg: Room commitment is required for private rooms and must be zero for public rooms.

types.name: CreateParams
docs: v2 CreateParams (Borsh, 171 bytes). `config_hash` is the canonical SHA-256 of the FULL
creator-chosen param set (streets, durations, feed, buy-in, fees…) — free-form within
operator bounds, no allowlist. `room_commitment` = sha256(roomcode ‖ creator) for
private rooms, zero for public.

fields.name: price_token
docs: 20-byte token/feed identifier signed by the signed-price-server.

fields.name: total_betting_duration_sec
docs: Total wall-clock betting span (Σ street durations + observation), bound in config.
`scheduled_end_ts` is derived on-chain at begin_live (= live_start + this).

fields.name: begin_live_window_sec
docs: Max delay after seal deadline for the operator to call begin_live (0 → default 30s).

fields.name: fill_window_sec
docs: Fill window (seconds). The on-chain `fill_deadline_ts` is derived as
`create_ts + fill_window_sec`; must lie within the operator-governed bounds.

types.name: MatchAccount
docs: One match. Holds the fee config, the bound-config hash (canonical hash of the full
creator-chosen param set), the private-room commitment, on-chain timing, the
commitment-derived button seed, and running totals. Custody of funds lives in the
associated `vault` token account PDA.
v2 seating model: a deposit creates a seat CANDIDATE. The backend confirms the playing
set at `lock` (FCFS by deposit finality, room-code-verified off-chain); only confirmed
seats play. Unconfirmed candidates can `refund` the moment the match leaves Filling.

fields.name: config_hash
docs: Canonical SHA-256 of the full creator-chosen param set (streets, durations, feed,
buy-in, fees…). Not interpreted on-chain; binds the off-chain config for audit.

fields.name: price_token
docs: 20-byte token/feed identifier signed by the signed-price-server.

fields.name: is_private
docs: True for private rooms (room-code gated off-chain, commitment recorded here).

fields.name: room_commitment
docs: `sha256(roomcode ‖ creator_pubkey)` for private rooms; all zero for public.

fields.name: fill_deadline_ts
docs: Fill deadline; after this, permissionless `void_before_start` if still Filling.

fields.name: lock_ts
docs: Set at `lock`: Clock::now when Filling -> Sealing.

fields.name: seal_deadline_ts
docs: `lock_ts + seal_window_sec`; seals must be recorded at or before this.

fields.name: live_start_ts
docs: Set at `begin_live`: Clock::now when Sealing -> Live.

fields.name: scheduled_end_ts
docs: `live_start_ts + total_betting_duration_sec`; oracle window anchor.

fields.name: total_betting_duration_sec
docs: Bound at create: total wall-clock betting span (Σ street durations + observation).

fields.name: seal_window_sec
docs: Bound at create: SEALING window length.

fields.name: begin_live_window_sec
docs: Bound at create: max delay after `seal_deadline_ts` within which the operator must
call `begin_live`. Keeps `scheduled_end_ts` tightly pinned to the seal round so a
timelock target can't be decrypted mid-match.

fields.name: signed_price_hash
docs: EIP-191 hash of the signed server price accepted at settlement.

fields.name: signed_price_timestamp_ms
docs: Signed server timestamp accepted at settlement, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: candidate_count
docs: Deposits recorded (confirmed or not). Bounded by `MAX_CANDIDATES`.

fields.name: confirmed_count
docs: Seats confirmed into the playing set at `lock`. Settlement covers exactly this many.

fields.name: sealed_count
docs: Confirmed seats that recorded a seal commitment by `seal_deadline_ts` (audit; set
at begin_live). Non-sealers still play — backend assigns the seal-close spot price.

fields.name: total_deposited
docs: Gross candidate inflow (buy-ins + entry fees). Audit total, NOT the pot.

fields.name: total_fees
docs: Confirmed entry fees (set at lock) + pot rake (added at settlement). Treasury-bound.

fields.name: button_seed
docs: keccak256 digest over the confirmed seats' seal data (normative preimage in
`begin_live`); recorded for audit/re-derivation.

fields.name: button
docs: Dealer button engine-seat index: `u64::from_le(seed[0..8]) % confirmed_count`.

types.name: MatchBounds
docs: Operator-governed match-creation bounds (see `ProtocolState`). Passed at
`initialize_protocol` and updatable via `set_match_bounds` (config_admin).

types.name: ProtocolState
docs: Global protocol controls and role registry.

fields.name: price_signer
docs: Ethereum/secp256k1 address allowed to attest settlement prices.

fields.name: buy_in_min
docs: Operator-governed match-creation bounds (config_admin). A match's `buy_in` must lie in
`[buy_in_min, buy_in_max]`, its fill window in `[fill_window_min_sec, fill_window_max_sec]`,
and its total betting duration in `[total_betting_duration_min_sec, total_betting_duration_max_sec]`,
enforced on-chain at create. Params are otherwise free-form (config_hash binds them).

fields.name: commitment
docs: Hash of the time-lock ciphertext (the prediction commitment): sha256(ciphertext).

fields.name: timelock_target
docs: drand round the prediction is time-lock encrypted to (must publish after match end).

types.name: SeatAccount
docs: One player's seat in a match. A deposit creates the seat as an unconfirmed CANDIDATE;
`lock` flips `confirmed` and assigns `engine_seat` for the playing set. The seal
commitment is recorded during Sealing (confirmed seats only). `payout` is written at
settlement; `refund` pays `deposit + entry_fee_paid`. Pull-based, idempotent via
`claimed`; account closes to the player on claim/refund.

fields.name: room_commitment
docs: `sha256(roomcode ‖ player_pubkey)` for private rooms (audit binding; enforcement is
backend confirm-at-lock); all zero for public rooms.

fields.name: confirmed
docs: True once the backend confirmed this seat into the playing set at `lock`.

fields.name: engine_seat
docs: Contiguous engine seat index (position in the confirmed set passed to `lock`);
`NO_ENGINE_SEAT` until confirmed. The engine + settlement index by this.

fields.name: prediction_commitment
docs: Hash of the time-lock ciphertext (prediction commitment).

fields.name: timelock_target
docs: drand round the prediction is time-lock encrypted to (match end).

fields.name: commitment_set
docs: True once a valid commitment was recorded at or before `seal_deadline_ts`.

types.name: SeatPayout
docs: Per-sealer payout indexed by engine seat (contiguous 0..sealed_count).

types.name: SettleArgs
docs: Settlement args — v1 trusts backend-computed payouts; the chain enforces conservation
and signed-price authenticity only. See `submit_settlement` TODO(v1+) for restoring
on-chain action-log replay + `verify_settlement`.

types.name: SignedPriceDto
docs: EIP-191/secp256k1 signed price payload emitted by the signed-price-server.
The signed bytes are exactly:
`token(20) || price_in_wad(32 byte uint256 BE) || timestamp_ms(32 byte uint256 BE)`.

types.name: VoidKind
docs: Why a match voided. Retained for audit; in v2 every void refunds the full
`deposit + entry_fee_paid` regardless of kind.
